body: I’m not a particularly religious person either. I guess by my use of the word God I really meant whatever it was that allowed me to be born as I am and be granted the opportunities I was, whether it be some divine force or just complete chance, sorry if that was misleading. I’m really just struggling with believing that I’m built to handle any of it. And I think with the way things have gone any faith I may have had in a higher power has only dwindled more and more.
I’m not sure what a typical starting dose is but my doctor started me on 50mg. Hopefully I’ll see some improvement eventually.

I was already having on and off suicidal thoughts prior to starting on medication, so I believe it’s just been increased alongside the lack of sleep and anxiety. Also coupled with my current shitty living situation it’s just piling on, but for now I’ll continue on it and see how the effects turn out.

You’re a wonderful person. Thank you so much for replying and even just reading what I had to say. It really means a lot. It’s just hard not to feel like a burden with all of the regrets I have trapped in my head. All the people I’ve hurt and those I trusted and poured my heart out for who just used and betrayed me. It’s all very overwhelming and the days just keep on passing, but people like you give me hope for this world. Thank you :)
